Write {"file_path":"D:\code\ESI.ts\tests\bdd\features\core\factions.feature","content":"Feature: Faction Warfare Management

  # EARS: Event-driven
  Scenario: WHEN getStats is called, the client shall return overall faction warfare statistics
    Given the faction warfare system is active
    When getStats is called
    Then the client shall return stats for all factions

  # EARS: Event-driven
  Scenario: WHEN getCharacterStats is called, the client shall return personal FW statistics
    Given a character enlisted in faction warfare is available
    When getCharacterStats is called
    Then the client shall return the character personal statistics

  # EARS: Unwanted behavior
  Scenario: IF the token is invalid for character FW stats, THEN the client shall throw a forbidden error
    Given an invalid or expired token for character stats is provided
    When getCharacterStats is called with the invalid token
    Then the client shall throw an EsiError with status 403 for character stats

  # EARS: Event-driven
  Scenario: WHEN getCorporationStats is called, the client shall return corporation FW statistics
    Given a corporation enlisted in faction warfare is available
    When getCorporationStats is called
    Then the client shall return the corporation FW statistics

  # EARS: Unwanted behavior
  Scenario: IF the token is invalid for corporation FW stats, THEN the client shall throw a forbidden error
    Given an invalid or expired token for corporation stats is provided
    When getCorporationStats is called with the invalid token
    Then the client shall throw an EsiError with status 403 for corporation stats

  # EARS: Event-driven
  Scenario: WHEN getSystems is called, the client shall return system ownership and contested status
    Given active faction warfare systems exist
    When getSystems is called
    Then the client shall return system ownership and contested status

  # EARS: Event-driven
  Scenario: WHEN getWars is called, the client shall return the list of faction conflicts
    Given faction warfare is active
    When getWars is called
    Then the client shall return the list of faction conflicts

  # EARS: Event-driven
  Scenario: WHEN getLeaderboardsOverall is called, the client shall return faction rankings
    Given faction warfare is active for the leaderboard
    When getLeaderboardsOverall is called
    Then the client shall return faction rankings

  # EARS: Event-driven
  Scenario: WHEN getLeaderboardsCharacters is called, the client shall return top character rankings
    Given faction warfare is active for the character leaderboard
    When getLeaderboardsCharacters is called
    Then the client shall return top character rankings

  # EARS: Event-driven
  Scenario: WHEN all FW endpoints are called concurrently, the client shall return a complete faction warfare picture
    Given an enlisted character for the FW overview is available
    When all FW data endpoints are called concurrently
    Then the client shall return a complete faction warfare picture
"}
